edition_title: Premium brands started shooting for the headset
subject: Premium brands are now shooting content made for the headset

hero.statement: Premium brands started shooting for the headset
hero.sub: Spatial content stopped being tech demos. Real brands are now filming stories meant to be lived inside, not watched on a rectangle.

sections.statement: A football giant shot a film for spatial
sections.body: Apple and Real Madrid teamed on an immersive documentary filmed during the 2025 to 2026 Champions League, with more than 30 Blackmagic immersive cameras capturing the match up close. It arrives in 2026 as premium content shot specifically for spatial viewing.
sections.why: When a club of that size films for the headset first, spatial becomes a brand channel, not a science project.

sections.statement: The platform grew up around real content
sections.body: visionOS 26 turns widgets spatial, adds lifelike depth to scenes, and supports 180 degree, 360 degree and wide field content from Insta360, GoPro and Canon. The pipeline to capture and publish spatial stories is finally something a normal crew can use.
sections.why: Standard cameras feeding a standard workflow means a brand can produce spatial content without a research lab.

sections.statement: Spatial is already working inside companies
sections.body: It is not only marketing. KLM built an Engine Shop app that speeds up aircraft maintenance with spatial computing. The same depth that sells a story on the outside is training and guiding teams on the inside.
sections.why: A tool that both markets and operates is a tool that survives the hype cycle. Spatial is passing that test.

invitation.headline: Make the story something they stand inside
invitation.body: Spatial rewards depth, presence and place. We design and produce immersive brand stories for the headset and the room, white label, under your name.
